body: **Foco:** Laboratório de exame 27 (TOEFL · IELTS · college).
**Pronúncia:** Expressividade.
**22 palavras novas** (negociações).
**Texto do dia:** e-mail, carta, mensagem.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo treinar a escrita de um e-mail formal de proposta e negociação (IELTS General Training Task 1).

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.subject: Proposal regarding order 4471
paras: Thank you for your quotation of 2 June. **Much as** we value your service, the price is higher than our budget allows. **Should** you be able to offer a 10% discount on orders above 500 units, we **would be willing to** sign a two-year contract.
In return, we **would commit to** paying within fifteen days. **Were** this acceptable, we **could** place the first order next week. I **look forward to** your reply by Friday.

items.q: He offers a two-year contract in exchange for a discount.
He needs a reply by Monday.

blocks.body: A proposta educada usa **concessão**, **condicional com inversão** (*Should you…, Were this…*) e **troca** (*in return*). Seja claro sobre prazo e números.

items.s: ___ you be able to offer a discount, we would sign. (Should)
___ this acceptable, we could order next week. (Were)
In ___ , we would commit to paying within fifteen days. (return)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: How do you propose an exchange politely
items.pt: Como você propõe uma troca com educação?

body: **In return,…** — Em troca,…
**Subject to…** — Sujeito a…
**Should you be able to…** — Caso você consiga…
**Were this acceptable,…** — Sendo isso aceitável,…
**We would be willing to…** — Estaríamos dispostos a…
**I trust this meets with your approval.** — Confio que isso mereça sua aprovação.
**Meet one’s budget** — Caber no orçamento
**Strike a bargain** — Fechar um bom negócio
**How do you propose an exchange politely?** — Como você propõe uma troca com educação?
**And a condition?** — E uma condição?
**Were this acceptable, we could order next week.** — Sendo isso aceitável, poderíamos fazer o pedido na semana que vem.

forms: She commits to a two-year deal.

items.label: Expressividade
items.note: Expressividade: varie altura, volume e velocidade para mostrar atitude; uma voz monótona soa desinteressada, mesmo com boas palavras.
words: That is NOT what I meant.

prompts.q: Open with thanks and a concession.
prompts.model: Thank you for your quotation. Much as we value your service, the price is high.
In return, we would commit to paying within fifteen days.
I look forward to your reply by Friday.

blocks.task: Write a formal email (8 sentences) proposing a deal: thanks, concession, proposal, exchange, condition, deadline.
blocks.model: Dear Mr. Silva, Thank you for your offer of 5 May. Much as we like the design, the cost is above our budget. Should you reduce the price by 8%, we would order forty units. In return, we would pay within ten days. Were this acceptable, we could confirm the order on Monday. We would also be glad to discuss delivery dates. I look forward to your reply by Friday. Yours sincerely, Ana Lima

body: IELTS GT Task 1: cubra todos os tópicos do enunciado e mantenha tom formal consistente.
Use condicionais invertidas com moderação e sem erro (Should you…, Were this…).
Reserve 3 minutos para revisão de registro e ortografia.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
